_about: Who is in which photo, for the gallery's Your Photos tab. households maps a letter key from src/data/attendees.json to the ids (in photos.json) of the photos anyone in that household is in; people lists the guests who are in at least one of them themselves. Only they get the tab, and it shows their household's photos. Made by scripts/people.mjs from the couple's naming of face groups; see README.md.
